_about: Age x ethnicity/nationality figures for the age selector (schema harm-data/age-bands/v1). Built from official sources; values are never imputed or pro-rated. Category labels are kept as published.

fit_codes.exact: published band(s) add up exactly to the standard band
fit_codes.derived_exact: obtained exactly by adding/subtracting published cells (no assumptions)
fit_codes.computed_microdata: our tabulation of an official record-level file, exact ages
fit_codes.estimated: only an overlapping published band exists; the value shown is for approx_band, never pro-rated
fit_codes.unavailable: no published or computable figure for this band

race_notes: Norway records immigrant category (immigrant, Norwegian-born to immigrant parents, rest of the population) and country group, not ethnicity. Labels as published by SSB.

Victims by age are crossed with immigrant category (one-off SSB article, 2017-2022 average). Suspects/charged persons by immigrant background are not published by age (SSB article tables 1a-3 and Statbank 09421 have no age).

series.title: Homicide victims by immigrant category and age, Norway, 2017-2022 average
series.descriptor: Person victims of reported offences, annual average 2017-2022 (SSB article table 6): Drap
series.race_basis: Immigrant category from the population register (innvandringskategori); labels as published by SSB

groups.label: I alt (all victims, incl. non-residents)
Øvrig befolkning (rest of the population: not immigrants or Norwegian-born to immigrant parents)
Innvandrere (immigrants)
Norskfødte med innvandrerforeldre (Norwegian-born to immigrant parents)

series.rate_unit: victims per 1,000 residents in the same immigrant category and age group (SSB; shown where one published age group matches; SSB gives no rates for Norwegian-born to immigrant parents)
series.native_note: SSB 5-year age groups 0-4 ... 75-79, 80 år og over, Uoppgitt alder. ':' = fewer than 5, suppressed by SSB.
notes: Drap = completed homicide (reported offences); attempted homicide not included.
'Øvrig befolkning' is the closest published group to the ethnic Norwegian population; it also includes people with one foreign-born parent and foreign-born people with a Norwegian-born parent.
Annual average of six years (2017-2022), published once in a 2024 SSB article; values may be non-integers in source rounding.
